lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. A central cluster of approximately 6-8 large blobs in the mid-flank region forms a roughly rectangular grid pattern with approximately equal horizontal and vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating visible anchor nodes where the vertical and horizontal patterns meet in the mid-body section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a bright dorsal edge and a distinct shadow on the ventral side, running from the post-branchial region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette displays a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 small, high-luminance spots concentrated primarily on the anterior and medial portions of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct yellowish-white patch of depigmented or scarred tissue is visible at the distal tip of the pectoral fin. A minor indentation or notch is also present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum and head area exhibit a significantly higher density of micro-spots compared to the lateral flank. Multiple small fish (remoras) are visible in the water column immediately ventral to the pectoral fin.
